patch.label: Quick Sword Check
patch.description: Fast high sword check with a tiny active window and clean recovery.

applied.reason: Short standing blade poke hits high and returns to guard.

patch.label: Low Santoryu Sweep
patch.description: Fast low three-sword sweep with very long active blade pressure.

applied.reason: Low sweep keeps the blades near shin height through a long sequence.

patch.label: Oni Giri Body Slash
patch.description: Quick mid body slash with a brief active cut and weak right tracking.

applied.reason: Forward body-height slash resembles an Oni Giri-style cut.

patch.label: Three-Sword Driving Cut
patch.description: Instant mid driving cut with very long active blade travel and quick recovery.

applied.reason: The move advances through repeated three-sword cutting poses at mid height.

patch.label: Two-Sword Cross Cut
patch.description: Slow mid cross cut with a long active blade path and weak right tracking.

applied.reason: Committed crossing sword arc fits a practical mid slash name.

patch.label: Three-Sword Low Draw
patch.description: Slow low draw slash with a long active sweep and quick recovery.

applied.reason: Long multi-blade draw sequence stays low across the opponent's legs.

patch.label: Oni Giri Launcher
patch.description: Slow mid launcher with long active rising blades that pop the opponent up.

applied.reason: Rising three-sword arc and existing launch height support launcher role.

patch.label: Santoryu Driving Cut
patch.description: Instant mid driving cut with very long active reach and quick finish.

applied.reason: Command variant reuses the long three-sword driving cut sequence.

patch.label: Low Sword Feint
patch.description: Slow low sword feint with a long active window and quick recovery.

applied.reason: Zoro dips into a low blade feint before returning upright.

patch.label: Dragon Twister Sweep
patch.description: Slow mid homing tornado sweep that knocks down and ends in crouch.

applied.reason: Spinning airborne slash path supports tornado, homing, knockdown, jump, and crouch-end flags.

patch.label: Santoryu Tatsumaki
patch.description: Slow mid jumping tornado slash that knocks down after a long active spin.

applied.reason: Obvious spinning three-sword sequence fits Zoro's Tatsumaki-style tornado role.

patch.label: Crouch Pressure Burst
patch.description: Fast mid crouch burst with long active pressure and almost no recovery.

applied.reason: Full-crouch command produces a compact pressure burst rather than a slash arc.

patch.label: Crouch Oni Launcher
patch.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with a tiny active cut and high recovery.

applied.reason: Crouch-to-rising slash carries authored launcher height.

patch.label: Overdrive Sword Jab
patch.description: Quick high overdrive sword check with a short active window.

applied.reason: Overdrive version uses the same high sword-check frames.

patch.label: Santoryu Aura Drive
patch.description: Slow special knockdown drive with long active aura-backed sword pressure.

applied.reason: Aura slash sequence is authored as a special knockdown with weak-right tracking.

patch.label: Rising Body Slash
patch.description: Fast mid while-rising slash with long active reach and weak right tracking.

applied.reason: While-standing command drives a blade through the body line.

patch.label: Rising Three-Sword Rush
patch.description: Fast mid rising rush with long active sword travel and quick recovery.

applied.reason: Rising sequence advances through several three-sword cuts.

patch.label: Ducking Sword Jab
patch.description: Quick high ducking sword check with a short active window.

applied.reason: Down jab repeats the quick high sword check.

patch.label: Diagonal Oni Launcher
patch.description: Slow mid diagonal launcher with a tiny active cut and heavy recovery.

applied.reason: Down-forward slash carries authored launcher height and weak-right tracking.

patch.label: Forward Sword Check
patch.description: Slow mid forward check with a brief active sword poke and heavy recovery.

applied.reason: Forward input produces a body-height sword check.

patch.label: Forward Body Slash
patch.description: Fast mid forward slash with long active reach and weak right tracking.

applied.reason: Forward-heavy command shares the body-height slash sequence.

patch.label: Santoryu Quick Check
patch.description: Quick high quarter-circle sword check with a short active window.

applied.reason: Quarter-circle jab is the same compact high sword check.

patch.label: Three-Sword Burst
patch.description: Fast mid knockdown burst with long active sword pressure and measured recovery.

applied.reason: Burst sequence shows multi-sword impact flashes and is authored as knockdown.
